custody: Bind the current permanent lock to the prior acquisition. Complete combined census and fresh source admission must match the original hold bytes/inode and every target snapshot. Retain the observation hold descriptor as well as target descriptors through closure. Reuse invokes no writer and changes no member, mode, bytes, identity or ownership; full combined capacity is permitted because no reference is added. Return the same inactive envelope, keeping the hold separate from strict target_sources.
fixtures: Every context immediately records four same-volume isolated roots and acquires two original inert runtime images plus one fresh observation. Evidence roots retain the already admitted native-proxy-observation-acquisition-20260910/cases namespace; the reuse result/ledger live under this audit log namespace. No fixture/compiler/native query/helper/capture/worker process is permitted. Trap publication only around reuse after fixture setup.
limits: Stable inert filesystem reuse only; supplied receipts and births are data, not authenticated native ownership. Complete interruption matrix, archive/capture settlement, release, compatibility, real contention and native qualification remain separately owned. Dated metadata/source closure does not promise arbitrary-writer atomicity or loaded-image attestation.
operation: reuse_observation_reference(case, request, previous_acquisition); fixed existing-only coordinator operation. Fresh two-argument acquisition remains unchanged and rejects existing holds.
request: Validate and defensively clone the closed prior successful inactive acquisition. Check zero authority/null executable, canonical lock path, canonical observation record/hold snapshot, matching runtime pair and prior workspace, canonical image key/source pair and five bounded byte/hash/identity snapshots in their original order. Request evidence identity and ordered births must match the original hold.
